title: Scenic Half Marathon Rayong Review: What the 2025 Edition Was Like
seo_title: Scenic Half Marathon Rayong Review | Laem Charoen Beach
meta_description: Scenic Half Marathon Rayong review: 4,500+ runners on a beach route past Laem Charoen, Saeng Chan and Suchada in 2025, under World Athletics standards.
dek: Rayong's stop on the Scenic Marathon Series is a seaside half marathon past three beaches. Here is what the 2025 edition was like, the one before the 2 August 2026 race.
verdict: The Scenic Half Marathon Rayong is a beach half marathon, part of Thailand's Scenic Marathon Series. The 2025 edition drew more than 4,500 professional and amateur runners to a coastal route past Laem Charoen, Saeng Chan and Suchada beaches [1]. It is run under Athletic Association of Thailand and World Athletics standards [1]. The title sponsor added a water tunnel, a cheer zone, a foot-soak station and free personal accident insurance of up to THB 100,000 for every runner [1]. If you want a seaside half marathon on Thailand's eastern coast, it is a pleasant choice. The only account available is the sponsor's.

sections.heading: The 2025 Edition
paragraphs: More than 4,500 runners, professional and amateur, took part in the 2025 race [1]. The route followed the coast past Laem Charoen, Saeng Chan and Suchada beaches [1].

Rayong is one stop in the Scenic Marathon Series, held under the standards of the Athletic Association of Thailand and World Athletics, alongside Chanthaburi, Krabi, Prachuap Khiri Khan and Nakhon Phanom [1].

sections.heading: The Race Village
paragraphs: The title sponsor, Prudential Thailand, ran a water tunnel, photo booth, cheer zone and foot-soak station, and gave every participant free personal accident insurance with cover of up to THB 100,000 [1]. That is a real benefit for runners travelling from abroad.

sections.heading: Should You Enter Next Year?
paragraphs: If you want an easy trip from Bangkok to a beach half marathon, yes. The route is the attraction.

Keep in mind the source. The account of 2025 is the title sponsor's, and nothing independent on the 2 August 2026 race had been published when this review was written, so look for runners' reports before you commit.
This review is compiled from the sponsor's account of the 2025 edition. It is not a first-hand race report, and nobody from this site ran the race.

faqs.question: What is the Scenic Half Marathon Rayong route like?
faqs.answer: A coastal route. In 2025 it ran past Laem Charoen, Saeng Chan and Suchada beaches in Rayong, on Thailand's eastern seaboard. The race is held under Athletic Association of Thailand and World Athletics standards.
